indexObservation.sourceTitle: How much do hostels cost around the world? Hostel Price Index for 2023 - Price of Travel
indexObservation.evidenceText: The Price of Travel methodology states that the Hostel Index price is per night, including taxes and fees, for one person in a shared dorm room, averaged over a Thursday and Friday night in mid-April 2023. The Tokyo row names Sakura Hostel Asakusa and lists $23.07.
indexObservation.referencePeriod: Average Thursday and Friday night in mid-April 2023; Hostel Index 2023
indexObservation.searchQuery: site:priceoftravel.com/how-much-do-hostels-cost-around-the-world Tokyo Japan Hostel Index dorm bed price
indexObservation.reason: Exact Tokyo row and explicit index methodology satisfy the one-person shared-dorm, nightly, tax-included contract.

currentBenchmark.evidenceText: The exact-property Booking.com result identifies a Bunk Bed in Mixed Dormitory Room for one guest and lists CNY169 per night excluding taxes and fees, but marks it as a 40% Getaway Deal and also shows multiple discounted/current amounts. The strict protocol rejects sale-only prices, so no benchmark is selected.
